title: 100% text-to-game AI-generated Silence of the Lambs Pixel Remake (full)
author: I_pee_in_shower
selftext:
Earlier I shared chapter 1. I've removed the game elements and focused on adapting the screenplay.  I want to highlight a few things:

  
1) The tooling is extensive development work, this isn't a one-shot prompt.  
2) This pipeline would presumably work on any screenplay. It will take about a week to produce something like this at current rates.  
3) The art is interesting. It's not AI generated in the traditional sense. Image models were not used. Everything is created from pixel primitives and created procedurally. There was some training feedback on the system but for the  most part I let the AI do it's thing. Good or bad it was their taste for the most part. Obviously I can go back and refine it but it's almost besides the point. Most of the music is AI generated. The exception are the midi versions of Goodbye Horses and the Goldberg Variations Aria. Their addition was my idea, not the AI :)  
4) Multiple models were used, from both Claude and OpenAI at different levels of reasoning. I've developed an entire orchestration pipeline.  
5) I'm going to show other projects. Unlike other people making Indie Games, I already have a senior role in software development, and I also do AI research as a PhD student. I'm doing it mostly for the love of the game. 

I also have a pipeline to publish to Steam or iOS, so if you have a game or concept you want to flesh out and want help send me a note and maybe we can collaborate.

P.S. Was thinking of doing the Intro Scene from LOTRs next...
